description: Completes a word search: takes the grid from generate_word_search (empty cells are "-") and fills them with random letters in the chosen language, with accents on or off. Letters follow how common they are in that language. Pass the puzzle's words so the filler never creates an extra copy of one.

accents.description: true (default): use the language's accented/native letters (Ñ, Ç, Ã, Ä, ẞ…). false: plain A-Z only.

empty.description: What marks an empty cell. Default "-".

grid.description: The grid from generate_word_search: rows of one-letter strings, "-" for empty cells.

lang.description: Language of the letters. Default es.

seed.description: Repeatable filler. Omit for a different filler every time.

words.description: The hidden words, so the filler cannot create an extra copy of one.

name: fill_word_search
title: Fill a word search with random letters
